title: Generalized Anxiety Disorder-2 (ultra-brief)
description: The first two items of the GAD-7 under the GAD-7 stem (instruction manual, Table 1: "First 2 items of GAD-7. Ultra-brief anxiety screener").

citation.text: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW, Monahan PO, Löwe B (2007). Anxiety disorders in primary care: prevalence, impairment, comorbidity, and detection. Annals of Internal Medicine 146(5):317–325.

source.note: Items 1–2 of the English GAD-7 form; the manual defines the GAD-2 as those items.

scoring.text: Sum of the two items (0–6), in gad2_total. The manual: "the recommended cutpoints for each when used as screeners is a score of 3 or greater".

items.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

rows.label: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
